title: SMTP: no mail loop detection (missing Received: hop count check)
description: smtp/src/relay.rs and the inbound SMTP handler do not count Received: headers to detect mail loops. A looping message can circulate indefinitely, consuming CPU and storage. Fix: before accepting a message for relay or local delivery, count Received: headers; reject with 554 if count >= 25 (RFC 5321 §6.3 recommended limit).
